goal: Production Service Level Objective (SLO) end-to-end drills.
summary: Implemented comprehensive Production SLO engine and end-to-end verification suite. Verified p95 latency targets (<= 300ms) for high-frequency static and read endpoints, upstream failure resilience (502/503 capacity limits and Retry-After exponential/fixed backoff handling), and 100% 2D rubbing fallback presence across all 9 Urns and 162 motif relics. Implemented strict anti-abuse release gates where any critical fake success (mock booking, fake payment, fabricated grade) blocks production deployment with GATE_BLOCKED, while valid executions produce a cryptographically signed GATE_PASSED release sheet.

files_modified_or_created.changes: Created ProductionSLOEngine implementing latency benchmark evaluation (p95 <= 300ms), upstream 502/503 resilience and Retry-After validation, 2D fallback availability checker, fake success audit engine, and signed release gate sheet assembler (SHA-256 seal).

Implemented 5-test comprehensive SLO verification suite covering read endpoint latency budgets, upstream 502/503 resilience and Retry-After contracts, 100% 2D rubbing fallback availability on disk and manifests, negative abuse release gate blocking on fake success, and end-to-end clean drill generating signed GATE_PASSED certificate.
Added Playwright E2E spec verifying browser-level read latency budget, 2D accessible fallback availability for Cao Đỉnh, and zero fake success on invalid visitor booking tokens.

invariants_verified.read_latency_budget: Static and read-only endpoints (/health, /api/v1/rbpc/config, /api/v1/heritage/places, /api/v1/history/stories, /api/v1/heritage/catalog) strictly achieve p95 <= 300ms.
invariants_verified.upstream_resilience_and_retry: Upstream capacity limits or 502/503 outages are handled gracefully with typed Retry-After headers, exponential backoff policies, or deterministic fallbacks.
invariants_verified.complete_2d_fallback_coverage: All 9 Imperial Urns and all 162 motif relief records maintain 100% verified 2D rubbing fallback assets on disk and in data registries.
invariants_verified.zero_fake_success_gate: Any simulation of critical transactional flows (instant payment mock, synthetic booking confirmation, fabricated student grade) strictly blocks release gate with GATE_BLOCKED.
invariants_verified.cryptographic_gate_sheet: Clean production runs generate a signed release gate report with SHA-256 integrity hash confirming all SLO criteria are satisfied.
